items.html: And know that when the VAK of Gadlut come, the three lower ones, the NHY of ZA, remain without the aforementioned Mochin of Gadlut. However, from there a little illumination is drawn from the lower NHY of the Mochin that are in the three middle ones of ZA, as mentioned in the intention of "Elokeichem Emet" (Your God is truth). And behold, as long as his GAR of Gadlut have not entered, the roots of the Chokhma and Bina do not spread in their places, for their root remained above in the Daat, joined with the Chokhma and Bina that have not entered; however, only their illumination enters and spreads in the VAK of Gadlut.
